verdict.rationale: Runloop provides infrastructure for agents to run unattended in Devboxes. Axons give agents a persistent event stream so they can suspend when idle, wake on demand, recover state and hand off between agents. Benchmark jobs are fully orchestrated by Runloop, a GitHub Action automates deployment, tutorials cover suspend/resume and turn-based PR workflows, and logs can be retrieved from completed executions. However, these are building blocks: the user must assemble the automation through the SDK, CLI or CI rather than configuring a ready-made background automation. Missing for 10: built-in scheduling/cron or event-trigger configuration for user automations, a first-party 'set up an automation' workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
